people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.
translations.bsb: David also took the men who were with him, each with his household, and they settled in the towns near Hebron.
translations.kjv: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
translations.asv: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
